meals.name: Sheet Pan Pork Sausage & Sweet Potatoes with Bell Peppers
meals.description: A flavorful and easy sheet pan dinner featuring sliced pork sausage, sweet potatoes, and bell peppers, ready in about 40 minutes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large sheet pan with parchment paper for easy cleanup.
Slice the smoked sausage into 1/2-inch thick rounds. Peel and chop sweet potatoes and bell peppers into 1-inch pieces. Slice the onion into wedges.

On the prepared sheet pan, combine sausage, sweet potatoes, bell peppers, and onion. Drizzle with olive oil, then sprinkle with dried oregano, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Toss well to coat all ingredients evenly.

Spread the mixture in a single layer on the sheet pan and roast for 25-30 minutes, or until sweet potatoes are tender and lightly caramelized, and sausage is slightly browned. Stir halfway through cooking. Serve hot.

meals.name: Quick Baked Chicken Taquitos with Refried Beans and Rice
meals.description: Crispy, kid-friendly baked chicken taquitos served with creamy refried beans and fluffy white rice, ready in about 40 minutes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Poach chicken breasts in simmering water or broth until cooked through, then shred finely. In a bowl, combine shredded chicken, cream cheese, shredded cheddar cheese, and taco seasoning. Mix well.

Warm corn tortillas slightly in the microwave (about 10-15 seconds per stack) to make them pliable. Fill each tortilla with about 2 tablespoons of the chicken mixture, roll tightly, and place seam-side down on a baking sheet.
Brush the tops of the taquitos lightly with vegetable oil. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy. Meanwhile, prepare the sides.

In a small saucepan, heat the refried beans over medium-low heat until warm, stirring occasionally. Cook white rice according to package directions, using chicken broth instead of water and adding 1/2 tsp salt. Serve the crispy taquitos with warm refried beans and rice.

meals.name: Slow Cooker Hearty Beef Pot Roast with Carrots & Potatoes
meals.description: Tender beef chuck roast cooked low and slow with vegetables in a savory broth, perfect for a comforting weeknight meal with minimal active cooking time.
instructions: Trim excess fat from the beef chuck roast. Season the roast generously with salt and pepper.

Place the roast in the slow cooker. Add beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, and diced tomatoes. Chop the onion, carrots, and potatoes into large chunks (approx. 1.5 inches) and mince the garlic. Add these vegetables to the slow cooker along with dried thyme and bay leaves.
Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours, until the beef is fork-tender.

Remove the roast and vegetables from the slow cooker and set aside. In a small bowl, whisk together cornstarch and water to create a slurry. Stir the slurry into the liquid in the slow cooker. Cook on high for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened. Shred the beef, discard bay leaves, and serve with the thickened gravy and vegetables.

meals.name: Speedy Chicken Fried Rice
meals.description: A quick and flavorful chicken fried rice, perfect for using up leftover chicken and rice, ready in under 30 minutes.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper. Mince garlic and grate ginger. Slice green onions, separating white and green parts.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the whisked eggs and scramble until just set, then remove from skillet and set aside.

Add a little more oil if needed. Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and white parts of green onions to the skillet; stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add frozen mixed vegetables and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.

Add day-old cooked rice and cooked chicken to the skillet. Break up any clumps of rice. Pour in soy sauce, sesame oil, and oyster sauce. Stir-fry for 5-7 minutes, ensuring everything is heated through and well combined. Stir in the scrambled eggs and green parts of the green onions. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Quick Lemon Herb Cod Skillet with Roasted Asparagus
meals.description: A light and healthy weeknight meal featuring pan-seared cod fillets and tender roasted asparagus with bright lemon and herbs, ready in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Trim the woody ends off the asparagus. Toss asparagus with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 10-12 minutes, until tender-crisp.
While asparagus roasts, pat cod fillets dry with paper towels. Season both sides with garlic powder, dried dill, dried parsley, salt, and pepper.

Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, carefully place cod fillets in the skillet. Sear for 3-4 minutes per side, or until the fish is flaky and cooked through (internal temperature 145°F / 63°C).
Remove cod from skillet. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the cooked cod and roasted asparagus. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Creamy Tomato & Sausage Penne Pasta
meals.description: A rich and comforting pasta dish with ground pork sausage in a creamy tomato sauce, perfect for a cozy weekend dinner.
instructions: Cook penne pasta according to package directions in salted boiling water. Drain and set aside, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta water.

While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add ground pork sausage and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and cooked through. Drain excess grease and remove sausage from the pan, setting aside.

Add chopped onion to the skillet and sauté for 3-5 minutes until softened. Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in diced tomatoes (undrained) and pasta sauce; bring to a simmer.

Reduce heat to medium-low, stir in heavy cream and cooked sausage. Simmer for 5-7 minutes, allowing flavors to meld. Stir in cooked penne pasta and parmesan cheese, adding reserved pasta water if the sauce is too thick. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Garnish with fresh basil if desired and serve hot.

meals.name: Classic Meatloaf with Roasted Red Potatoes and Sautéed Green Beans
meals.description: A comforting, protein-rich meatloaf served with tender roasted red potatoes and fresh sautéed green beans, a perfect Sunday family dinner.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). In a large bowl, combine ground beef, panko bread crumbs, egg, milk, chopped onion, minced garlic, 1/4 cup ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, dried parsley, salt, and black pepper. Mix gently until just combined, being careful not to overmix.

Form the meat mixture into a loaf shape (approximately 9x5 inches) and place it in a loaf pan or on a foil-lined baking sheet. Spread the remaining 1/4 cup ketchup evenly over the top of the meatloaf.

Roast red potatoes: Wash and quarter the red potatoes. Toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper on a separate baking sheet. Place in the oven with the meatloaf. Bake meatloaf and potatoes for 50-60 minutes, or until the meatloaf reaches an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C) and potatoes are tender.

While meatloaf rests for 10 minutes after baking, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add green beans and sauté for 5-7 minutes until tender-crisp. Season with salt and pepper. Slice meatloaf and serve alongside roasted potatoes and green beans.
